integrity: Same-model mathematical reconstruction and exact finite computational corroboration are reported. No independent audit, published provenance, or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for real dyadic Haar soft thresholding with common positive threshold, unchanged mean and nonperiodic adjacent variation. It gives a provably exact nine-state recurrence, not a claimed elementary formula for all depths, and quantitative logarithmic growth bounds; independent review and historical priority checks are outstanding.
title: Exact nine-state computation and logarithmic path-variation instability of finite Haar soft thresholding
